jobs.title: Armed Entry Control Officer — Career Growth & Benefits
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Houston, TX is seeking an Armed Entry Control Security Officer to monitor government site access, verify credentials, and maintain a respectful, safe environment for clients and visitors.

You will conduct patrols, respond to incidents, document activity, and work a schedule that includes evenings and weekends. Applicants must have relevant security experience, an armed guard card, and meet age and background screening requirements.
